title: Canonical compact-support site comparison construction
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $f:X	o Y$ a morphism of schemes, and $c=(j:X\hookrightarrow\overline X,p:\overline X	o Y)$ a compactification [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Work in the derived categories of ordinary constant-$A$ module sheaves on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $
u_W^*$ for exact comparison pullback, both on bounded-below and on ambient derived categories [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. Let $F_{\mathrm{et}}^c=Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}Dj_{\mathrm{et},!}$ be the etale compact-support candidate [def-amb-etale-compact-support], and set $F_{\mathrm{proet}}^c=Rp_{\mathrm{proet},*}Dj_{\mathrm{proet},!}$ using pro-etale extension by zero and ordinary derived direct image [def-weil-extension-by-zero] [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Define the bounded-below comparison $F_{\mathrm{et}}^c
u_Y^*\cong
u_X^*F_{\mathrm{proet}}^c$, with functor products in left-to-right order, by reassociation, the canonical proper direct-image mate $Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}
u_Y^*	o
u_{\overline X}^*Rp_{\mathrm{proet},*}$, then the exact open-extension comparison $Dj_{\mathrm{et},!}
u_{\overline X}^*\cong
u_X^*Dj_{\mathrm{proet},!}$, and reassociation. The proper map is the mate of the comparison pullback square, fixed by the actual inverse-image/direct-image units and counits [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate], and is regarded as an isomorphism using its established invertibility for proper $p$, which is quasi-compact and quasi-separated [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate]. The open comparison is the termwise descent of the canonical sheaf comparison of Stacks 09AF. Define also the ambient comparison $\iota_X
u_X^*F_{\mathrm{proet}}^c\cong\iota_XF_{\mathrm{et}}^c
u_Y^*$ on $D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ by the inverse of that bounded-below comparison and the canonical compatibility isomorphisms with the bounded-below inclusions $\iota$. These are the specified composites, without any choice of an unrelated isomorphism.

lean.statement:
def compactSupportSiteComparison (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f) :
    DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ⋙ (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c ≅
      DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ⋙
        Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c ⋙
          (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Y).mapDerivedCategory
